comment: PromQL function definition for Kibana. See https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/querying/functions/
name: count_values
description: Counts the elements that have the same sample value, returning one series per distinct value with the value as the label `label`. When used with `by`, `count_values` counts independently within each group.

params.name: label
params.description: Name of the label holding each sample value.
